name: Ishmael
overview: The Scriptures reveal Ishmael as the son of Abraham and Hagar, born when Abraham was eighty-six years old, and named because God heard Hagar's affliction (Genesis 16:11,15-16). Ishmael is described as a 'wild man' whose hand will be against everyone, yet God promised to bless him, make him fruitful, and establish twelve princes from his descendants, forming a great nation (Genesis 16:12; 17:18,20). Abraham's prayer for Ishmael's well-being before God underscores God's sovereign blessing upon him despite Ishmael not being the child of promise through Isaac.
